    Compute Negative Log-Likelihood for Long-Term Stochastic Growth

    like_neg_ltsgr_cpp.Rd

    This function calculates the negative of the long-term stochastic growth likelihood using a C++ implementation optimized with RcppParallel. It applies transformations to environmental data and computes the likelihood based on specified parameters.

    like_neg_ltsgr_cpp(
  env_dat,
  mu,
  sigl,
  sigr,
  o_mat,
  n_threads = RcppParallel::defaultNumThreads()
)

    Arguments

    env_dat

    array A 3-dimensional numeric array of environmental data with dimensions:

    • [p] Number of environmental variables

    • [ts_length] Time series steps

    • [n] Number of locations

    Must not contain missing values.

    mu

    numeric vector Length-p vector of location parameters (means) for each environmental variable.

    sigl

    numeric vector Length-p vector of left-side standard deviations (asymmetry).

    sigr

    numeric vector Length-p vector of right-side standard deviations (asymmetry).

    o_mat

    matrix A p x p orthogonal matrix used for rotation in parameter space.

    n_threads

    integer Number of threads for parallel computation. Defaults to RcppParallel::defaultNumThreads().

    Value

    numeric scalar The negative log-likelihood value computed from the environmental data and parameters.

    Details

    Internally, this function:

    1. Reshapes the environmental data into a matrix.

    2. Computes inverse matrices for asymmetry adjustments.

    3. Calls the C++ function like_ltsg() for efficient likelihood computation.

    Note

    Ensure that env_dat has positive detections and no missing values. All parameter vectors (mu, sigl, sigr) must have length equal to the number of environmental variables (p).

    Examples

    # Example usage:
o_mat <- matrix(c(-0.4, 0.9, -0.9, -0.4), ncol = 2)
mu <- c(11, 5)
sigl <- c(1, 1.5)
sigr <- c(1.5, 1.4)
env_dat <- array(runif(2 * 3 * 2, min = 4, max = 12), dim = c(2, 3, 2))
like_neg_ltsgr_cpp(env_dat, mu, sigl, sigr, o_mat)
#> [1] 6.090820 7.588247
